subject: Can I use a plot as a semi-transparent background?

messages.author: 40b63348dbcb447d
messages.subject: Can I use a plot as a semi-transparent background?
parts: I want to add a semi-transparent plot (generated by R, not simply a PNG) to the first page of my (HTML5) slide. Is it possible? Thank you.

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Can I use a plot as a semi-transparent background?
parts:
If you want a background image, that is likely to be the issue of your
software package which makes the HTML5 slides for you, and it is
almost irrelevant to knitr, although knitr can generate an image for
you. Please consult the author of that software instead.

Regards,
Yihui
